precise_format_issue: Only wrapper-side KDM62D_RETURN used the kdm6 REAL(16) cloud_bal_state_values buffer and passed all 16 values to a state-row helper while the block header declared field_count=15. This produced one extra uninitialized value per row and shifted subsequent block framing in that stage.
unaffected_by_that_specific_width_issue: PRE_UPDATE and POST_PROCESS execute inside KDM62D with a separate REAL(15) cloud_bal_state_values buffer; their whole-array writer arguments matched the 15-field header. Public 14-field writers passed slices. The corrected source makes the three private writers explicit at 1:15.
disposition: Exclude the prior full pair from any validated state-path analysis. Histories were not compared after discovering the format issue. No physical interpretation was made from those malformed records.
